question: Pandit Birju Maharaj was a legendary _________ dancer, who opened his dance school ‘Kalashram’ in New Delhi.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kathak**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Pandit Birju Maharaj was a renowned exponent of Kathak, a classical dance form originating from Northern India.
 
• He was born on February 4, 1938, and came from a family of Kathak dancers, including his father, Acchan Maharaj.
 
• Birju Maharaj was known for his expressive storytelling, graceful movements, and intricate footwork.
 
• He received several prestigious awards, including the Padma Vibhushan in 1986, for his contributions to Kathak.
 
• In 1998, he established his dance school, 'Kalashram,' in New Delhi to promote and teach Kathak to future generations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kathak**:

 
 
• One of the eight major classical dance forms of India, known for its dramatic and expressive style.
 
• The word 'Kathak' is derived from 'Katha,' meaning story, and the dance form involves storytelling through rhythmic and graceful movements.
 
 
 
• **Padma Vibhushan**:
 
 
• India's second-highest civilian award, given for exceptional and distinguished service in any field including art, literature, science, and public services.
 
 
 
• **Kalashram**:
 
 
• An institute founded by Pandit Birju Maharaj dedicated to the preservation and promotion of Kathak and other traditional arts.
 
• Kalashram offers training in dance, music, and other performing arts, continuing the legacy of Kathak.
 
 
 
• **Footwork (Tatkaar)**:
 
 
• One of the most distinctive features of Kathak, involving intricate and fast-paced foot movements, often synchronized with the tabla (drum).
 
 
 
• **Abhinaya**:
 
 
• A critical element in Kathak, referring to the art of expression through facial gestures, body language, and hand movements to convey emotions and stories.
